title: PID Recycling Causes Conflation With New OS Process and Dangerous Kill

minimized_scenario.failure_mode: Reconciler saw PID 4120 in process table, assumed worker was hung, and issued SIGKILL terminating innocent daemon
minimized_scenario.expected_safe_outcome: DEFINITE_MISMATCH (PID recycled; lease closed, no kill issued)
minimized_scenario.invariant_violated_without_repair: PID alone is not process identity; multi-factor tuple (PID + StartTime + Token) required
